name: application-api-rate-limit-meter
title: API Rate Limit Meter
description: Proactive per-window API request-quota meter with a proportional fill bar and a reset-time note — distinct from rate-limit-notice, which is a reactive alert banner shown only after the limit is already hit, and from usage-meter, which is a generic storage-quota bar with no time-window/reset semantics.
useWhen: Showing live API request usage against a quota before the limit is hit.
You need a reset countdown alongside the usage proportion.
A near-limit warning state should change color and copy automatically.
avoidWhen: The limit has already been exceeded and you need a blocking alert — use rate-limit-notice instead.
You're tracking generic storage or seat usage with no time-window reset — use usage-meter instead.
You need per-endpoint breakdowns in a table — a data table is more appropriate.
responsiveBehavior: The card is fluid up to a max width; the endpoint path truncates and the used/quota counts stay right-aligned at narrow widths.
accessibility: The fill bar carries role='img' with an aria-label stating exact used/quota counts and percentage, since width alone isn't announced by screen readers.
The near-limit state is conveyed by both an amber fill color and explicit 'Approaching limit' text, not color alone.
Request counts use toLocaleString formatting for readability at scale.

variants.title: API rate limit meter
variants.description: An endpoint at 84.2% of its 1,000-request quota (842 used), in the near-limit warning state with a 12-minute reset note, on a light surface.
accessibility: Fill percentage is requestsUsed/requestsQuota, computed live rather than hand-typed.

variants.title: API rate limit meter (Dark)
variants.description: The same near-limit rate meter, adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Fill and warning text colors meet WCAG AA contrast on dark backgrounds.
